peopleAlsoAsk.question: Are people allergic to sodium alginate?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: In rare instances, allergic reactions to sodium alginate can occur. Symptoms of an allergic reaction may include rash, itching, swelling, dizziness, and difficulty breathing. These reactions are uncommon but require immediate medical attention if they occur.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is chitosan an alginate?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Abstract. Alginate and chitosan are two marine natural polymers with unique structures and properties. Alginate is a polymeric acid, whilst chitosan is a polymeric amine. Both polymers can be made into fibers through the wet-spinning process.
